observation.visible_scene: A static top‑down view of a wooden floor. In the center is a large multi‑colored spiral made of upright dominoes (blue/green on the outer ring, then yellow/orange, red/pink toward the inner rings). Additional white domino runs are visible: a long straight row across the top, a zigzag at the top‑left, and an L‑shaped run on the left whose vertical arm ends near a small wooden block, separated by a gap from the outer end of the spiral.
visible_changes: The vertical arm of the left L‑shaped white run progressively tilts and lies down across the excerpt (upright in early frames, leaning/flat by mid‑to‑late frames).

Starting around the outer‑left end of the spiral (~9 o'clock), dominoes begin to tilt and fall; a falling wave propagates along the outer ring toward the top (~11–12 o'clock), so that by the last frames a growing arc of blue‑topped dominoes at the upper‑left of the ring is lying flat while the rest of the ring is still upright.
As part of this outer‑ring collapse, one blue domino ends up lying just outside the spiral's outer outline at the upper‑left, a position empty in the first frame.
The inner rings of the spiral, the long top white row, and the top‑left zigzag remain upright and unchanged throughout the excerpt.
The camera and background floor planks stay fixed (no camera motion).
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the left white run's fall is what initiates the spiral collapse, or whether the two motions are independent; the gap/wooden block between them is not clearly bridged in view.
The eventual completion of the spiral fall (the excerpt ends with only the outer‑left arc down and most of the spiral still standing).
What triggered the very first motion, since both ends of the clip are arbitrary crop boundaries.
uncertain_details: Exact frame at which the left vertical arm first begins to tilt vs. the spiral outer end.
Whether the blue piece lying outside the ring was flung out or simply fell outward onto that spot.
Precise direction label of the wave (it moves from the 9‑o'clock outer end upward along the ring).
